ReadmitIQ Stage 4: Classical Machine Learning Models¶

One-Line Promise: Training, evaluating, and ablating classical linear and ensemble models with and without RAG precedents, analyzing class imbalance weighting dynamics, and optimizing validation decision thresholds.

What This Stage Covers¶

From the ReadmitIQ project specification, Stage 4 delivers the classical machine learning benchmark suite:

  1. Classical Model Family Design: Evaluating linear modeling (Logistic Regression), bagging (Random Forest), and gradient boosted decision trees (LightGBM, labeled as an extra).
  2. Full-Cohort Training: Fitting all model architectures on the complete 69,535 training encounters using preprocessor isolation.
  3. Comprehensive Validation Evaluation: Computing 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for AUC-ROC, F1, precision, recall, top-10% precision/lift, Brier score, and ECE on the full 14,902 validation split.
  4. Class Imbalance Study: A focused empirical ablation evaluating unweighted ($1.0\times$) vs. balanced vs. scaled ($7.7\times$) weighting on ranking vs. calibration vs. threshold mechanics.
  5. Validation-Only Decision Threshold Optimization: Maximizing $F_1$ score strictly on validation predictions, establishing clinical operating points.
  6. Confusion Matrix Diagnostics: Quantifying clinical trade-offs across True Negatives, False Positives, False Negatives, and True Positives.
  7. Exact Verification against Saved Ablation Table: Auditing differences against reports/metrics/ablation_table.json and flagging any discrepancy $> 0.002$.
  8. Model Artifact Persistence: Saving newly trained models exclusively under models/stages/ (preserving models/final/ untouched).
  9. Computed Stage Checklist: Programmatic verification of model training, metrics parity, and saved figures.
  10. Next Stage Pointer: Handover to Stage 5 (Transformer-Based Model & Clinical Note Embeddings).

Inputs and Outputs of Stage 4¶

  • Inputs Read (Existing Artifacts):
    • data/processed/train_rag.parquet & val_rag.parquet (69,535 & 14,902 encounters)
    • models/final/preprocessor_base.joblib & models/final/preprocessor.joblib (Fitted tabular transformers)
    • configs/config.yaml (Model hyperparameters and random seed)
    • reports/metrics/ablation_table.json (Pre-computed validation benchmarks)
    • src/evaluate.py (Evaluation metrics and bootstrap CI functions, imported read-only)
  • Outputs Produced (New Artifacts Strictly Confined):
    • models/stages/stage4_lr_base.joblib, models/stages/stage4_lr_rag.joblib
    • models/stages/stage4_rf_base.joblib, models/stages/stage4_rf_rag.joblib
    • models/stages/stage4_lgbm_base.joblib, models/stages/stage4_lgbm_rag.joblib
    • reports/stages/figures/stage4_model_comparison_roc.png (Validation ROC curves)
    • reports/stages/figures/stage4_precision_recall_curves.png (Validation PR curves)
    • reports/stages/figures/stage4_class_imbalance_experiment.png (Weighting study)
    • reports/stages/figures/stage4_confusion_matrices.png (Confusion matrix heatmaps)
    • notebooks/stages/stage4.ipynb (Executed notebook)
    • reports/stages/stage4.html (Exported HTML report)

1. Feature Pipelines & Data Loading¶

Purpose: Load the full training (69,535 rows) and validation (14,902 rows) datasets alongside the base tabular preprocessor and the RAG-augmented preprocessor. Verify strict column separation and target prevalence.

In [2]:
# Load preprocessed datasets with RAG features
t0_load = time.time()
train_rag = pd.read_parquet(REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "train_rag.parquet")
val_rag = pd.read_parquet(REPO_ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "val_rag.parquet")

# Load preprocessors
pb_path = REPO_ROOT / "models" / "final" / "preprocessor_base.joblib"
pr_path = REPO_ROOT / "models" / "final" / "preprocessor.joblib"

preprocessor_base = joblib.load(pb_path)
preprocessor_rag = joblib.load(pr_path)

# Extract feature names
num_cols_base = preprocessor_base.transformers_[0][2]
cat_cols_base = preprocessor_base.transformers_[1][2]
num_cols_rag = preprocessor_rag.transformers_[0][2]
cat_cols_rag = preprocessor_rag.transformers_[1][2]

y_train = train_rag["readmitted_30d"].values.astype(int)
y_val = val_rag["readmitted_30d"].values.astype(int)

# Preprocess Base Features
X_tr_base = preprocessor_base.transform(train_rag[num_cols_base + cat_cols_base])
X_va_base = preprocessor_base.transform(val_rag[num_cols_base + cat_cols_base])

# Preprocess RAG Features
X_tr_rag = preprocessor_rag.transform(train_rag[num_cols_rag + cat_cols_rag])
X_va_rag = preprocessor_rag.transform(val_rag[num_cols_rag + cat_cols_rag])

# Format for native LightGBM categoricals
def prepare_lgbm(df, num_cols, cat_cols):
    d = df[num_cols + cat_cols].copy()
    for col in cat_cols:
        d[col] = d[col].astype("category")
    return d

X_lgbm_tr_base = prepare_lgbm(train_rag, num_cols_base, cat_cols_base)
X_lgbm_va_base = prepare_lgbm(val_rag, num_cols_base, cat_cols_base)
X_lgbm_tr_rag = prepare_lgbm(train_rag, num_cols_rag, cat_cols_rag)
X_lgbm_va_rag = prepare_lgbm(val_rag, num_cols_rag, cat_cols_rag)

load_duration = time.time() - t0_load

print(f"Loaded and transformed full cohorts in {load_duration:.2f}s:")
print(f"  Train: {len(train_rag):,} rows | Positives: {np.sum(y_train):,} ({np.mean(y_train)*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"  Val:   {len(val_rag):,} rows | Positives: {np.sum(y_val):,} ({np.mean(y_val)*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"  Base Matrix: {X_tr_base.shape[1]} one-hot features | RAG Matrix: {X_tr_rag.shape[1]} features (+rag_struct_rate_k20)")

takeaway_s1 = (
    f"Preprocessed train ({len(train_rag):,} rows) and validation ({len(val_rag):,} rows) splits. "
    f"Base feature matrix contains {X_tr_base.shape[1]} features, expanded to {X_tr_rag.shape[1]} features with RAG precedent rate."
)
print(f"Takeaway: {takeaway_s1}")

2. Model Training & Full Validation Evaluation¶

Purpose: Train the complete six-model matrix (Logistic Regression and Random Forest, plus LightGBM labeled as an extra, with and without RAG) on the FULL train split using the exact configuration parameters. Evaluate all models on the full validation split with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

In [3]:
# Define output directory for Stage 4 models (Rule 1 compliant)
stages_models_dir = REPO_ROOT / "models" / "stages"
stages_models_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

models_config = {
    "Logistic Regression (Base)": {
        "model": LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, random_state=RANDOM_SEED),
        "X_tr": X_tr_base, "X_va": X_va_base, "type": "sklearn", "rag": False, "save_name": "stage4_lr_base.joblib"
    },
    "Logistic Regression (RAG)": {
        "model": LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, random_state=RANDOM_SEED),
        "X_tr": X_tr_rag, "X_va": X_va_rag, "type": "sklearn", "rag": True, "save_name": "stage4_lr_rag.joblib"
    },
    "Random Forest (Base)": {
        "model": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=12, min_samples_split=10, class_weight="balanced", n_jobs=-1, random_state=RANDOM_SEED),
        "X_tr": X_tr_base, "X_va": X_va_base, "type": "sklearn", "rag": False, "save_name": "stage4_rf_base.joblib"
    },
    "Random Forest (RAG)": {
        "model": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, max_depth=12, min_samples_split=10, class_weight="balanced", n_jobs=-1, random_state=RANDOM_SEED),
        "X_tr": X_tr_rag, "X_va": X_va_rag, "type": "sklearn", "rag": True, "save_name": "stage4_rf_rag.joblib"
    },
    "LightGBM (Base) [Extra]": {
        "model": LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=150, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, scale_pos_weight=7.7, random_state=RANDOM_SEED, n_jobs=-1, verbose=-1),
        "X_tr": X_lgbm_tr_base, "X_va": X_lgbm_va_base, "type": "lgbm", "rag": False, "save_name": "stage4_lgbm_base.joblib"
    },
    "LightGBM (RAG) [Extra]": {
        "model": LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=150, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, scale_pos_weight=7.7, random_state=RANDOM_SEED, n_jobs=-1, verbose=-1),
        "X_tr": X_lgbm_tr_rag, "X_va": X_lgbm_va_rag, "type": "lgbm", "rag": True, "save_name": "stage4_lgbm_rag.joblib"
    },
}

trained_models = {}
val_predictions = {}
metrics_results = []

print("=" * 85)
print("TRAINING AND EVALUATING THE CLASSICAL MODEL COMPARISON MATRIX")
print("=" * 85)

for model_name, cfg in models_config.items():
    t0_fit = time.time()
    clf = cfg["model"]
    clf.fit(cfg["X_tr"], y_train)
    fit_duration = time.time() - t0_fit
    
    # Save model artifact strictly in models/stages/
    save_path = stages_models_dir / cfg["save_name"]
    joblib.dump(clf, save_path)
    
    # Validation probability predictions
    y_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(cfg["X_va"])[:, 1]
    val_predictions[model_name] = y_pred_proba
    trained_models[model_name] = clf
    
    # Evaluate validation metrics
    m = evaluate_predictions(y_val, y_pred_proba, n_bootstraps=500, seed=RANDOM_SEED)
    m["model_name"] = model_name
    m["rag_feature"] = cfg["rag"]
    m["train_time_sec"] = fit_duration
    metrics_results.append(m)
    
    print(f"[{model_name}] Fit: {fit_duration:.1f}s | Val AUC: {m['auc_roc']:.4f} (95% CI: {m['auc_ci_95']}) | Opt Thresh: {m['optimal_threshold']:.4f} | Prec@10%: {m['precision_top_10pct']:.4f}")

# Display validation metrics comparison table
metrics_df = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        "Model": m["model_name"],
        "RAG": "Yes" if m["rag_feature"] else "No",
        "Val AUC-ROC": f"{m['auc_roc']:.4f}",
        "95% CI": f"[{m['auc_ci_95'][0]:.4f}, {m['auc_ci_95'][1]:.4f}]",
        "Optimal Thresh": f"{m['optimal_threshold']:.4f}",
        "Max F1": f"{m['f1']:.4f}",
        "Precision": f"{m['precision']:.4f}",
        "Recall": f"{m['recall']:.4f}",
        "Prec @ Top 10%": f"{m['precision_top_10pct']:.4f}",
        "Lift @ Top 10%": f"{m['lift_top_10pct']:.2f}x",
        "Brier Score": f"{m['brier_score']:.4f}",
        "ECE": f"{m['ece']:.4f}",
    }
    for m in metrics_results
])

display(metrics_df)

3. Auditing Differences vs Saved Ablation Table (< 0.002 Parity Audit)¶

Purpose: Per the project guidelines, compare the newly computed validation metrics directly against reports/metrics/ablation_table.json. Flag any discrepancy $> 0.002$ to verify rigorous reproducibility.

In [4]:
# Load pre-computed ablation table
ablation_file = REPO_ROOT / "reports" / "metrics" / "ablation_table.json"
with open(ablation_file, "r") as f:
    saved_ablation_data = json.load(f)

saved_results_map = {
    f"{r['model']} ({'RAG' if r['rag_feature'] else 'Base'})" + (" [Extra]" if "LightGBM" in r['model'] else ""): r
    for r in saved_ablation_data["ablation_results"]
}

comparison_rows = []
any_flagged = False

for m in metrics_results:
    m_name = m["model_name"]
    saved_m = saved_results_map.get(m_name)
    if saved_m:
        saved_auc = saved_m["auc_roc"]
        new_auc = m["auc_roc"]
        diff = abs(new_auc - saved_auc)
        flag = diff > 0.002
        if flag:
            any_flagged = True
            
        comparison_rows.append({
            "Model Configuration": m_name,
            "Saved Ablation AUC": f"{saved_auc:.4f}",
            "Recomputed Stage 4 AUC": f"{new_auc:.4f}",
            "Absolute Difference": f"{diff:.4f}",
            "Max Tolerance": "0.0020",
            "Audit Status": "FLAGGED (>0.002)" if flag else "PASSED (Identical)"
        })

comp_df = pd.DataFrame(comparison_rows)
display(comp_df)

max_auc_diff = max(float(r["Absolute Difference"]) for r in comparison_rows)
print(f"\nMax Absolute AUC Difference across all models: {max_auc_diff:.4f} (Tolerance: 0.0020)")
assert not any_flagged, f"Discrepancy detected above 0.002 tolerance! (Max diff: {max_auc_diff:.4f})"

takeaway_s3 = (
    f"All 6 classical models reproduce saved ablation benchmarks with a maximum absolute discrepancy of {max_auc_diff:.4f}, "
    f"well within the strict 0.0020 project tolerance limit."
)
print(f"Takeaway: {takeaway_s3}")

4. Class Imbalance Weighting Study: Unweighted vs Balanced vs Scaled¶

Purpose: In clinical readmission prediction, the positive class represents only ~11.4% of encounters. We conduct a focused empirical experiment analyzing the behavior of unweighted ($1.0\times$) vs. balanced vs. scaled ($7.7\times$) loss weighting across rank discrimination (AUC), probability calibration (Brier / ECE), and decision thresholds.

In [5]:
# Focused class imbalance experiment using LightGBM
weights_to_test = [
    ("Unweighted (1.0x)", 1.0, STAGE_PALETTE["neutral_dark"]),
    ("Moderately Weighted (3.0x)", 3.0, STAGE_PALETTE["secondary"]),
    ("Fully Scaled (7.7x Negative/Positive)", 7.7, STAGE_PALETTE["alert"]),
]

imbalance_results = []
imbalance_probs = {}

for label, spw, color in weights_to_test:
    clf = LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=120, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, scale_pos_weight=spw, random_state=RANDOM_SEED, n_jobs=-1, verbose=-1)
    clf.fit(X_lgbm_tr_rag, y_train)
    p_va = clf.predict_proba(X_lgbm_va_rag)[:, 1]
    imbalance_probs[label] = p_va
    
    # Rank metrics
    auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, p_va)
    k_idx = np.argsort(p_va)[::-1][:int(0.10 * len(p_va))]
    prec_10 = float(np.mean(y_val[k_idx]))
    lift_10 = prec_10 / float(np.mean(y_val))
    
    # Calibration metrics
    brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, p_va)
    ece = compute_ece(y_val, p_va)
    
    # Threshold metrics
    ps, rs, ts = precision_recall_curve(y_val, p_va)
    f1s = 2 * ps * rs / (ps + rs + 1e-8)
    best_th = float(ts[np.argmax(f1s)])
    best_f1 = float(np.max(f1s))
    
    # Default 0.5 threshold metrics
    p_def = (p_va >= 0.5).astype(int)
    f1_def = float(f1_score(y_val, p_def, zero_division=0))
    prec_def = float(precision_score(y_val, p_def, zero_division=0))
    rec_def = float(recall_score(y_val, p_def, zero_division=0))
    
    imbalance_results.append({
        "Weighting Scheme": label,
        "Scale Factor": spw,
        "Color": color,
        "AUC-ROC": auc_val,
        "Brier Score": brier,
        "ECE": ece,
        "Mean Pred Risk": np.mean(p_va),
        "Prec @ Top 10%": prec_10,
        "Lift @ Top 10%": lift_10,
        "Optimal Thresh": best_th,
        "Max F1": best_f1,
        "Default Thresh (0.5) F1": f1_def,
        "Default Thresh Recall": rec_def
    })

imbalance_df = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        "Weighting Scheme": r["Weighting Scheme"],
        "AUC-ROC": f"{r['AUC-ROC']:.4f}",
        "Brier Score": f"{r['BrierScore']:.4f}" if "BrierScore" in r else f"{r['Brier Score']:.4f}",
        "ECE": f"{r['ECE']:.4f}",
        "Mean Predicted Risk": f"{r['Mean Pred Risk']*100:.1f}%",
        "Prec @ Top 10%": f"{r['Prec @ Top 10%']:.4f}",
        "Optimal Thresh (Max F1)": f"{r['Optimal Thresh']:.4f} (F1: {r['Max F1']:.3f})",
        "Default Thresh (0.50)": f"F1: {r['Default Thresh (0.5) F1']:.3f} | Recall: {r['Default Thresh Recall']*100:.1f}%"
    }
    for r in imbalance_results
])

display(imbalance_df)

takeaway_s4 = (
    f"Class imbalance weighting does NOT meaningfully alter rank discrimination (AUC ranges from {imbalance_results[0]['AUC-ROC']:.4f} "
    f"to {imbalance_results[2]['AUC-ROC']:.4f}). Instead, weighting shifts predicted probability mass (mean risk from {imbalance_results[0]['Mean Pred Risk']*100:.1f}% "
    f"to {imbalance_results[2]['Mean Pred Risk']*100:.1f}%), degrading raw Brier calibration from {imbalance_results[0]['Brier Score']:.4f} to {imbalance_results[2]['Brier Score']:.4f} "
    f"while enabling effective operation around standard decision thresholds."
)
print(f"Takeaway: {takeaway_s4}")
Weighting Scheme AUC-ROC Brier Score ECE Mean Predicted Risk Prec @ Top 10% Optimal Thresh (Max F1) Default Thresh (0.50)
0 Unweighted (1.0x) 0.6713 0.0965 0.0051 11.4% 0.2570 0.1334 (F1: 0.283) F1: 0.011 | Recall: 0.5%
1 Moderately Weighted (3.0x) 0.6710 0.1209 0.1496 26.3% 0.2564 0.2950 (F1: 0.280) F1: 0.137 | Recall: 8.6%
2 Fully Scaled (7.7x Negative/Positive) 0.6729 0.2199 0.3435 45.7% 0.2584 0.5522 (F1: 0.282) F1: 0.277 | Recall: 59.5% 
Takeaway: Class imbalance weighting does NOT meaningfully alter rank discrimination (AUC ranges from 0.6713 to 0.6729). Instead, weighting shifts predicted probability mass (mean risk from 11.4% to 45.7%), degrading raw Brier calibration from 0.0965 to 0.2199 while enabling effective operation around standard decision thresholds.

ax1.set_xlabel("Predicted Probability", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax1.set_ylabel("Density", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax1.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax1.legend(fontsize=8.5, frameon=True, facecolor="white")

# Panel 2: Reliability / Calibration Curves
ax2 = axes[1]
from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve
for res in imbalance_results:
    probs = imbalance_probs[res["Weighting Scheme"]]
    prob_true, prob_pred = calibration_curve(y_val, probs, n_bins=10)
    ax2.plot(prob_pred, prob_true, marker="o", lw=2.0, color=res["Color"], label=f"{res['Weighting Scheme'].split(' ')[0]} (ECE: {res['ECE']:.3f})")
ax2.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], color="#9CA3AF", linestyle="--", label="Perfect Calibration")
ax2.set_title("Reliability Diagram (Calibration)", fontsize=11, weight="bold")
ax2.set_xlabel("Mean Predicted Probability", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax2.set_ylabel("Empirical Readmission Rate", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax2.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8.5, frameon=True, facecolor="white")

# Panel 3: F1 Score vs Operating Threshold
ax3 = axes[2]
for res in imbalance_results:
    probs = imbalance_probs[res["Weighting Scheme"]]
    ps, rs, ts = precision_recall_curve(y_val, probs)
    f1s = 2 * ps * rs / (ps + rs + 1e-8)
    ax3.plot(ts, f1s[:-1], lw=2.0, color=res["Color"], label=f"{res['Weighting Scheme'].split(' ')[0]} (Peak: {res['Max F1']:.3f})")
    ax3.scatter([res["Optimal Thresh"]], [res["Max F1"]], color=res["Color"], s=50, zorder=5)
ax3.axvline(0.50, color="#9CA3AF", linestyle=":", label="Default Threshold (0.50)")
ax3.set_title("F1 Score vs Decision Threshold", fontsize=11, weight="bold")
ax3.set_xlabel("Decision Threshold", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax3.set_ylabel("F1 Score", fontsize=10, weight="semibold")
ax3.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 0.35)
ax3.legend(fontsize=8.5, frameon=True, facecolor="white")

plt.suptitle("Class Imbalance Dynamics: Trade-Offs in Risk Calibration and Operating Thresholds", fontsize=13, weight="bold", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
fig_imb_path = save_stage_figure(fig, "stage4_class_imbalance_experiment.png")
plt.show()

takeaway_fig_imb = (
    f"Weighting shifts probability mass toward 0.5 without changing ranking order. "
    f"Unweighted models require custom threshold tuning (~{imbalance_results[0]['Optimal Thresh']:.2f}), "
    f"whereas weighted models operate naturally around conventional 0.5 thresholds but require post-hoc calibration."
)
print(f"Takeaway: {takeaway_fig_imb}")

6. Confusion Matrix Diagnostics at Optimal Validation Thresholds¶

Purpose: Evaluate the clinical operational trade-offs for patient triage: analyzing True Negatives, False Positives (over-intervention cost), False Negatives (missed readmissions), and True Positives (successful alerts) at the tuned validation decision threshold.

In [8]:
# Plot Confusion Matrix Heatmaps for 4 primary models
primary_models = [
    "Logistic Regression (Base)",
    "Logistic Regression (RAG)",
    "Random Forest (RAG)",
    "LightGBM (RAG) [Extra]"
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(16, 4.2), dpi=150)

cm_records = []

for ax, name in zip(axes, primary_models):
    probs = val_predictions[name]
    m_info = next(m for m in metrics_results if m["model_name"] == name)
    th = m_info["optimal_threshold"]
    preds = (probs >= th).astype(int)
    
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_val, preds)
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    
    sens = tp / (tp + fn)
    spec = tn / (tn + fp)
    ppv = tp / (tp + fp)
    npv = tn / (tn + fn)
    
    cm_records.append({
        "Model": name,
        "Operating Threshold": f"{th:.4f}",
        "True Negatives": tn,
        "False Positives": fp,
        "False Negatives": fn,
        "True Positives": tp,
        "Sensitivity (Recall)": f"{sens*100:.1f}%",
        "Specificity": f"{spec*100:.1f}%",
        "PPV (Precision)": f"{ppv*100:.1f}%",
        "NPV": f"{npv*100:.1f}%"
    })
    
    # Heatmap
    sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt=",d", cmap="Blues", cbar=False, ax=ax,
                xticklabels=["Pred: No", "Pred: Yes"], yticklabels=["Actual: No", "Actual: Yes"])
    ax.set_title(f"{name.split(' [')[0]}\nThresh: {th:.2f} | Sens: {sens*100:.1f}%", fontsize=10, weight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("True Outcome", fontsize=9, weight="semibold")
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted Action", fontsize=9, weight="semibold")

plt.suptitle("Clinical Confusion Matrices at Optimal Validation Operating Thresholds", fontsize=12, weight="bold", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
fig_cm_path = save_stage_figure(fig, "stage4_confusion_matrices.png")
plt.show()

# Display tabular confusion breakdown
cm_table = pd.DataFrame(cm_records)
display(cm_table)

takeaway_s6 = (
    f"At tuned operating thresholds, LightGBM (RAG) captures {cm_records[3]['Sensitivity (Recall)']} of all 30-day readmissions "
    f"({cm_records[3]['True Positives']:,} true positives) while maintaining {cm_records[3]['Specificity']} specificity, "
    f"providing a practical balance for clinical post-discharge intervention programs."
)
print(f"Takeaway: {takeaway_s6}")

8. Next Stage Pointer¶

Next Stage: Proceed to notebooks/stages/stage5.ipynb (Stage 5: Transformer-Based Model & Clinical Note Embeddings).

In Stage 5, we examine deep clinical narrative processing:

  • DistilBERT Tokenization & Architecture: Class-weighted cross-entropy loss, sequence length distributions, and attention patterns.
  • Colab Prediction Auditing: Validating and evaluating saved DistilBERT out-of-sample predictions (distilbert_val_predictions_notes.csv & _rag.csv) on the exact 14,902 validation encounters.
  • Comparative Benchmarking: Paired bootstrap comparisons of transformer representations against classical linear and tree models.
  • Resource Governance: Transparent reporting of GPU vs. CPU runtime limits and training trade-offs.
